burn(uint256).details: Function to burn a token, only callable by the owner.

params.tokenId: The ID of the token to burn.

params.limit: The maximum number of token IDs to return.
params.owner: The address of the owner to get the token IDs for.
params.skip: The number of token IDs to skip (for pagination).

initialize(string,string,address).details: This function is called during the deployment of the contract to set up initial values.

params._lockedToken: The address of the token that is being locked in the positions.
params._name: The name of the NFT collection.
params._symbol: The symbol of the NFT collection.

mint(address,(uint256,uint256,uint256,ui.details: Function to mint a new token with a position, only callable by the owner.

params.position: The position details to associate with the token.
params.to: The address to mint the token to.

returns._0: tokenId The ID of the newly minted token.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

safeTransfer(address,uint256).details: Function to safely transfer a token to another address, only callable by the owner of the token.

params.to: The address to transfer the token to.
params.tokenId: The ID of the token to transfer.
The ID of the token to generate the SVG for.

returns._0: The SVG string representing the token's position.

transferFrom(address,address,uint256).details: Function to transfer a token from one address to another, emitting a MetadataUpdate event (for the NFT marketplaces). Caller must be pre-approved.

params.from: The address to transfer the token from.
params.to: The address to transfer the token to.
params.tokenId: The ID of the token to transfer.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

getOwnedTokenIds(address,uint256,uint256.notice: Returns the token IDs owned by a specific address.

initialize(string,string,address).notice: Initializes the LockPositionsNFT contract with the given parameters.

lockedToken().notice: Getter for the token, that is being locked.

nextTokenId().notice: Getter for the next token ID to be minted.

positions(uint256).notice: Retrieves the position details for a given token ID.

tokenURI(uint256).notice: Generates the SVG representation of a token's position.
